title: Microphone Frequency Visualization with FFT
description: Real-time frequency spectrum visualization of microphone input with color-coded frequency bars and peak frequency detection.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Signal Processing
FFT
Audio Analysis
Data Visualization
learningObjectives: Identify the peak frequency of a sung or whistled tone from the peak-detection readout and the tallest color-coded bar
Distinguish low-frequency content, drawn as blue bars, from high-frequency content, drawn as red bars, across the spectrum
Compare the harmonic content of a voice, a musical instrument, and broadband noise by the number and spacing of their spectral peaks
Predict how lowering the maximum frequency slider rescales the horizontal axis and spreads the remaining bars across the display
Explain why pressing Stop freezes the last computed spectrum on screen rather than clearing the display
